research_question: Can a physical-domain conforming triangular P1 Galerkin Neumann discretization with exact planar roof boundaries and the original 8node q0 source/observer remove nonmonotone sliver-cutcell frequency artifacts of exact-volume face-aperture FV? Compare five original grids before observing new solution outcomes.

fixed_original.original_q0: native original one-sample q[0]=1, in_sigs[:,0] preserved, all n>0 zero

new_spatial_method.architecture: x extruded 1D lumped P1 FE tensor physical yz conforming 2D P1 Galerkin triangles mass-lumped, true exact planar Neumann natural boundary
new_spatial_method.yz_nodes: all Cartesian original native yz nodes lying in physical polygon retained; supplement exact points along all four true boundary segments, including all intersections of the true sloped roof with y,z native grid lines; merge duplicates only by fixed 12 decimal coordinate key
new_spatial_method.yz_triangulation: scipy.spatial.Delaunay of exact physical polygon all interior and boundary vertices, keep all triangles including near-boundary skinny triangles, no cutcell/spectral deletion or regularization
new_spatial_method.yz_K: sum true element polygon triangle area * c² * gradients(N_a) dot gradients(N_b), symmetric positive semidefinite, Neumann natural
new_spatial_method.yz_M: physical P1 Galerkin consistent element mass row sum A/3 diagonal lumping (positive), not fitted
new_spatial_method.x_nodes: original native x-axis physically inside [0,4] retained with exact physical endpoints 0 and 4 inserted; original x sample nodes retained
new_spatial_method.x_K: physical standard P1 line elements c²/dx [[1,-1],[-1,1]], natural Neumann
new_spatial_method.x_M: P1 positive lumped element mass dx/2 per end
new_spatial_method.true_3d_operator: M=Mx tensor Myz, K=Kx tensor Myz + Mx tensor Kyz
new_spatial_method.source_receiver: map each of exact original eight native x,y,z Cartesian HDF5 sample indices to exactly preserved FE nodes; preserve per-node original q0 and receiver weights; zero load on additional physical roof nodes; reject absent/duplicate original sample
new_spatial_method.time: same previous beta=1/4 Newmark exact full-mode q0 kick A/(1+dt²lambda/4), A=dt²*c²*(mass-normalized original 8node source-receiver overlap)
